name: eu-pii-redact
description: Redact European personal data (names, national IDs, IBANs, emails, phones) in text and files, and restore it later.
long_description: Replaces personal data with placeholders like [PERSON_1] and [IBAN_1]. redact_file and restore_file process files without the personal data ever entering the conversation. Detects names from evidence, national ID numbers from 21 EU/EEA countries (validated by check digit and birth date), IBANs, cards, EU VAT numbers, emails, phones and IPs. Needs a RapidAPI key for the EU PII Redaction API (free plan: 500 requests/month). Requires uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) on the machine.

tools.name: redact_text
tools.description: Redact personal data in a text; returns placeholders and entity types, not the original values.

tools.name: redact_file
tools.description: Redact a UTF-8 file into a new file without reading it into the conversation; writes a restore mapping.

tools.name: restore_file
tools.description: Put the original values back into a file using the mapping, offline.

rapidapi_key.title: RapidAPI key
rapidapi_key.description: Your RapidAPI key, subscribed to EU PII Redaction (the free plan works): https://rapidapi.com/JulianJohansen/api/eu-pii-redaction/pricing
